description: Offline-first REST API client for VS Code. No login required, no cloud dependency.
configuration.historyMaxItems.descriptio: Maximum number of history entries to keep. When the limit is exceeded, the oldest unpinned entries are removed automatically.
Disable HTTPS certificate validation only for HTTPS requests that use self-signed certificates. Use this only when necessary.
configuration.displayLanguage.descriptio: Display language used by Arc Client panels, prompts, and notifications. The guide uses a localized README only when one exists. VS Code locale is ignored and English remains the default until you change this setting.
configuration.workspaceProfile.descripti: Workspace-local storage profile used for collections, history, environments, default headers, and saved tabs. Switch profiles to isolate Arc Client data per project or workflow.
